sourceCopy.name: Meeting Minutes Template
sourceCopy.title: Meeting Minutes Template Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Create structured meeting minutes with attendees, decisions, and action owners and due dates. Edit, print, or export Markdown.
sourceCopy.intro: Use a clear meeting-minutes template for attendees, agenda topics, decisions, and action items. Every action can include an owner and due date.
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Record the meeting title, date, facilitator, attendees, agenda, decisions, and action items. Assign an owner and due date to each action so follow-up is clear.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Are my meeting notes uploaded or saved?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The template runs in this browser tab. It does not automatically save or upload your notes; export a Markdown file or print them if you want a copy.

additionalFaqs.question: How should I format an action item?
additionalFaqs.answer: Enter one action per line as task | owner | due date, using a valid YYYY-MM-DD date, for example: Send notes | Sam | 2026-10-16.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I print or export the minutes?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Preview the structured notes, download them as a Markdown file, or use the print option in your browser.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this tool record or transcribe a meeting?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It does not access a microphone or create a transcript. You enter the notes and decisions yourself.
